thread.title: Here are the post-election stock-market winners in the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq - MarketWatch

author: Philip van Doorn
title: Here are the post-election stock-market winners in the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq - MarketWatch

organizations.name: horizons marijuana life sciences etf hmmj

text:
Midterm elections historically lead to stock market rallies, regardless of the results. Wednesday was no exception when there was a late-day rally in marijuana stocks adding icing to the cake.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.25% rose 545 points, or 2.1%, to close at 26,180.30. The S&P 500 Index SPX, -0.05% was up 2.1%, while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -0.29% added 2.6%.
A split in party control of the two houses of Congress tends to cheer investors .
The resignation of Attorney General Jeff Sessions — at President Trump’s request — added fuel to the broad rally and helped stretch a seven-day rally for marijuana stocks . It’s too early, of course, to consider whether Trump’s eventually nominee to replace Sessions will share the outgoing AG’s opinion that legalizing the recreational use of cannabis is a bad idea. The ETFMG Alternative Harvest exchange-traded fund MJ, -3.83% rose 7.1%, while the Horizons Marijuana Life Sciences ETF HMMJ, -3.56% was up 8.1%. Shares of Aurora Cannabis ACB, -3.22% ended the day 9% higher, while Tilray TLRY, -9.74% was up 31%, and Cronos Group CRON, -5.40% rose 8.4%.
All stocks in the Dow Jones Industrial Average were up on Wednesday, except for Procter & Gamble PG, -0.03%
